Skill-sync v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Detects new or modified local skills and automatically syncs them to ClawHub and GitHub.
- Tracks sync status for each skill, including version, publish ID, and commit hash.
- Supports manual and scheduled (cron) sync, with command-line options.
- Generates sync status and detailed sync reports.
- Provides error handling, rollback support, and Discord-style status notifications.
